Within the broader context—likely a parsing or validation routine—this exception is thrown to indicate a format error. The programmer's use of a specific exception type with a detailed message suggests an intent to allow the caller to recognize and handle the error condition gracefully, rather than treating it as an unrecoverable programming bug.
